content: {"episode_id":"ep-05160","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"The claim for CPT 93247, a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study, was denied under Reason Code PR-204 as not covered under the member's current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent dizziness that have persisted despite initial management for supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes I47.1 and R42. Per the indication note, a long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated to further characterize the arrhythmia and correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. We request reconsideration of the PR-204 determination for CPT 93247 on the basis of this documented medical necessity."}
